caption: A Seoul court dismissed Belift Lab's 2 billion won damages suit against former ADOR CEO Min Hee-jin on Nov. 13, and dismissed her 5 billion won countersuit too. First-instance ruling; Belift Lab says it will appeal. Sources: Yonhap (via The Korea Times), Korea JoongAng Daily. #kpop #illit #newjeans #hybe #kpopnews

scenes.title: THE CASE
events: Belift Lab sues for 2 billion won
scenes.caption: Both sides' claims *dismissed.*

a.text: Said the copying claim was false and harmed the label and ILLIT.

b.text: Said the label's rebuttal spread false claims and caused damage.
